company.name: Dartboard
company.shortDescription: A forecasting platform for trend spotters, number crunchers, and everyone in between.
company.description:
Dartboard is a software platform for forecasting anything from sales results, to new trends, to whether or not your company softball team will make the playoffs.

Forecasting is notoriously a blend of art and science. It's hard to capture decades of someone's experiences in a machine learning or AI model, but it's easy for them to answer a question if it is put simply. By tracking those answers over time and understanding the context behind them, we help you unlock better, more accurate forecasts.

productsAndServices.description: A web-based tool for creating and participating in forecasting tournaments, allowing users to make predictions on various topics and track changes over time.
productsAndServices.name: Forecasting Platform
